featured_reviews.name: Cedric Noronha
featured_reviews.review_text: A Roman Catholic Church located in Borivli. Built in 1993 by the Salesians of Don Bosco, this church is dedicated to St. John Bosco. Its interior is spacious having wooden pews, stained glass window panes, ceiling fans, chandelier etc. The facade of this church is modern having a wall sculpture of Don Bosco along with young children. There is a grotto within the church premises. Also, there is a school attached to the church. Had attended a mass service in this church in English language. It is an ideal place for local devotees as well as people of other faith.

featured_reviews.name: Viveca Dourado
featured_reviews.review_text: Being a catholic, it’s with a heavy heart I write this. Regret having my wedding nuptials at St. John Bosco parish, Borivali. In the name of ‘nuptial fees/donation’ whatever they call it, we were exploited and charged 7 times more than the usual amount, and neighbouring parishes in other areas charge nothing close to that. This ‘fee’ did not include anything and additionally we were expected to give extra ‘fees’ to their Sacristy and Digital team. Deeply disappointed for a Catholic Church. Strongly encourage couples to sought other parishes for their Nuptials.

featured_reviews.name: Madhavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Lady of Remedy Church in Kandivali West is a peaceful and welcoming place that holds deep spiritual significance for the local community. The church has a calm and prayerful atmosphere, making it an ideal space for reflection, worship, and inner peace, even amidst the busy surroundings of the city.

The church is well maintained and aesthetically pleasing, with a simple yet beautiful interior that helps devotees focus on prayer. The Masses are well organized, meaningful, and conducted with devotion, making them spiritually uplifting for people of all ages. The choir and liturgy add to the reverent experience, especially during feast days and special occasions.

One of the most admirable aspects of Our Lady of Remedy Church is its strong sense of community. The parish actively engages in social, educational, and charitable activities, encouraging unity and service among parishioners. The clergy and volunteers are approachable, supportive, and dedicated to guiding the faithful.

Overall, Our Lady of Remedy Church is not just a place of worship but a spiritual home for many. It stands as a symbol of faith, hope, and togetherness in Kandivali West, and is highly recommended for anyone seeking a serene and spiritually enriching experience.

featured_reviews.name: Sania Serrao
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our Lady of Remedy Church in Borivali is not just a place of worship, but a space filled with peace, faith, and a strong sense of community. The church stands beautifully with its serene surroundings, offering a calm escape from the busy pace of city life.

As you step inside, there’s an immediate feeling of quiet reflection and comfort. The interiors are simple yet graceful, creating a spiritual atmosphere that invites prayer and contemplation. Regular masses, novenas, and festive celebrations bring the parish community together, especially during important occasions like Christmas and the annual feast.

What makes this church truly special is the warmth of the people and the welcoming environment. Whether you visit for prayer, a special ceremony, or simply to find a moment of peace, Our Lady of Remedy Church leaves you feeling spiritually uplifted and connected.

Mass Timings (From 1st March 2017)

Sunday – 7 am, 8 am (Children’s mass), 9 am and 6 pm

Week Days – 6 am, 6:45 am and 7 pm

Saturday – 6 am, 6:45 am and 7:00 pm

First Friday of Every month – Holy hour at 6:30 pm followed by mass at 7:00 pm

Tamil Mass – Every Thursday at 5:45 pm and Second and Fourth Sunday at 10 am

name: City Rock Church Mumbai
description:
City Rock Church Mumbai is a movement to reaching the unreached, lost, last, least and backsliders. An urban based contemporary Church with Missions as our DNA. We want to see young people rise up to become pioneers and leaders to change the nation.

A youth focused and a platform which engage every young soul with music, games and activities, a vibrant and productive congregation. We strive for something out-of-box in order to equip this generation where our fundamentals remain the same but a different approach to share the same Gospel in modern ways.

featured_reviews.name: Mahima Mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
City Rock Church Mumbai is incredible. The fellowship here reflects pure, unconditional love among Gen Z and youth churchmates. The worship is refreshing, and you can truly feel God's presence.
This English church community is located near me, and they feel like one big, loving family. The sermons are always relevant and speak directly to the needs of a youth church. Pastor Shailesh, Pastor Aishwariya, and leaders like Anugrah Dada have all been a huge inspiration.
Everyone deserves to experience a community like this—it’s life-changing. This church in Mumbai has drawn me closer to God and made my walk with Christ more joyful.

featured_reviews.name: Gaurav Mohite
featured_reviews.review_text: City Rock Church in Mumbai impressed me with its warm and inviting atmosphere during my first Sunday church service there. Vibrant worship and empowering sermons positively influenced my spiritual journey, fostering a sense of belonging among hospitable Gen Z and youth church mates. Dedicated ministries and leaders provide mentorship, support, and fellowship. Additionally, it is conveniently located as an English church near me. I highly recommend it for its relevant teaching and strong sense of church community.

featured_reviews.name: Phukhato Sema
featured_reviews.review_text: Coming from Assam (North East) I was looking for a Church in Mumbai on internet where they preach the Biblical doctrine and I landed in CRC, Mumbai. I was rest assured that I don’t have to find another Church!  If you are a youth and searching for a Church, well without any second thought visit City Rock Church, you won’t regret! It has an energetic and enthusiastic vibe. Friendly people, amazing hospitality and not to forget the spirit filled Praise & Worship followed by the word of God by amazing pastors.

featured_reviews.name: Sandesh Gaikwad
featured_reviews.review_text: God has changed my life amazingly ever since I've started going to City Rock Church Mumbai. I've learnt so many things about Christ through my leaders. The parts of the service are taken care of nicely. It makes me feel like I'm home. This community has helped me to discover the purpose of my life!

featured_reviews.name: Amruta Dhiwar
featured_reviews.review_text: The church is the place where we come together to encourage one another as member's of Christ's body. Together we fulfill an important purpose on the Earth. That is what I feel about City Rock Church, Mumbai. Ps Shailesh and Ps. Aishwarya are very good leaders if you are looking for good spiritual growth. I highly recommend this church if you are in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Cedric Noronha
featured_reviews.review_text: A Syro Malabar Catholic Church located on a hillock in Borivli. Built in 2008, this church is affiliated to the Diocese of Kalyan and is a sub center of Our Lady of Immaculate Conception Church. Its interior is spacious and well lit having wooden pews, stained glass window panes, ceiling fans, chandelier etc. The facade of this church is simple & modern. There is a grotto within the church premises. Also, there is Holy Qurbana in Malayalam language everyday. Had attended a mass service in this church in English language. It is an ideal place for local devotees as well as people of other faith.
